current_events: An RSF drone strike in Sudan’s Blue Nile State kills 41 displaced people
War crimes in the Sudanese civil war, 2026 Blue Nile campaign

Isaias strengthens into a category 3 Atlantic hurricane. It would later weaken to category 2, with 365,000 people in Alabama and Florida, United States, reported to be without power ahead of its landfall
Isaias makes landfall near Destin, Florida, and weakens to a category 1 hurricane
2026 Atlantic hurricane season

Flooding is reported in areas of Southern California, including Long and Newport Beach, and the National Hurricane Center issues a tropical storm warning for the area. The warning is the first issued for San Diego County, California, since 2023 during Hurricane Hilary
Simon strengthens into a category 2 Pacific hurricane
A magnitude 7.7 earthquake strikes Herrera Province, Panama. A nationwide tsunami warning is issued
A passenger bus collides with a truck on a road in Mkambarani, Morogoro Region, Tanzania, and catches fire, killing 28 people
Eight more children in Bangladesh are reported to be killed from measles, bringing the death toll past 1,155
2026 Bangladesh measles outbreak
Montenegro expels Russian military blogger Mikhail Zvinchuk and four other Russian nationals on national security grounds after detaining them in Risan
Six people suspected of stealing Pierre-Auguste Renoir's paintings Young Woman at the Well and Madame Colonna Romano are arrested, and the artworks are recovered
South African judge and former United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights Navi Pillay is awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for "her efforts to promote peace and international law"

Clashes erupt in New York City, United States, between protestors and police after the shooting of a Dominican Republic national with a criminal conviction by ICE agents. The man, who was in a car alongside a child, was then detained while being wounded
Shootings by U.S. immigration agents in the second Trump administration

The Supreme Federal Court of Brazil issues an arrest warrant for Eduardo Bolsonaro, the brother of presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, on charges of lobbying the U.S. to interfere in the trial of his father, former president Jair Bolsonaro

A man armed with a knife takes 13 children and staff members hostage at a school in Curitiba, Paraná, Brazil, and threatens to set it on fire, before being shot dead by police. The hostages are rescued, with two children sustaining injuries
Nine people are killed, including the perpetrator, in a mass shooting at a home in Erie, Pennsylvania, United States

Palestinian Vice President Hussein Al Sheikh informs that Palestinian legislative election planned for November 28 will be postponed, possibly until September 2027, along with the also delayed presidential election, because of worsening conditions throughout the ‌Palestinian territories
Next Palestinian legislative election
Czechs begin voting in the first round to elect one-third of the Senate. Incumbent prime minister Andrej Babiš seeks gains of his coalition in the Senate. Municipal elections are also underway
2026 Czech Senate election, 2026 Czech municipal elections
The Mauritanian government of Prime Minister Moctar Ould Diay resigns over power outages. However, President Mohamed Ould Cheikh El Ghazouani reappoints Diay, asking him to form a new government
Pope Leo XIV approves Filipino cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle's election as dean of the College of Cardinals, making him the first Asian to lead the body that elects a new pope
